framing: Re-scored: the recorded live model outputs of the 2026-10-17.deepseek-vision-exp AMD Token Factory run, replayed through the current decision rules. No new model calls.
scope: component validation on public RealWaste images — not field data from a plant
disclosure: This live run was made under the current decision rules, which were tuned on the 2026-10-13 run of these same 80 images (hard contaminants read from the structured fields only; plastic film and textile treated as RDF feedstock). The images are not new to the rules, so these rates are not a held-out result. Only a live run on unseen images can confirm them.
llm_note: The live rows recorded the LLM's gate outcome, not its text, so the replayed LLM result is rebuilt from the recorded manifest_crosscheck state with a fixed confidence of 0.95. That confidence only fills the ocr_confidence gate value, which has no threshold and never moves the verdict. The VLM prompt was not changed for this re-score; latency is not re-measured (no model was called).
